Subject: Request: Reserved capacity for Q4 model launch

Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Quick one: our engineering and infra teams are aligned on a hard launch window in mid-August for CalderaAI v2 (new LLM ensemble + fine-tuned reranker). We have a sales-backed commitment that requires predictable throughput for the first 12 weeks post-launch.

High-level ask: 200 dedicated A100-equivalent GPUs reserved with a 3-month commit and an option for burst to 260 for the first 6 weeks of launch. We understand this is a large request; attached is our sizing worksheet showing peak RPS and expected token volume (caldera_capacity_request.xlsx).

Timing is tight — can Redwood provide a firm yes/no and suggested delivery window by COB Friday? If there are alternative proposals (partial reserve + burst, phased ramp) we’re open to discussing.

Subject: Fwd: Request: Reserved capacity for Q4 model launch — quick triage

Forwarding Caldera’s ask. TL;DR: 200 GPUs reserved for 3 months, burst option to 260 for first 6 weeks. Attached sizing sheet from the customer.

Options I see (quick):
- Option A (Conservative): Offer 80 GPUs reserved + burst to 150 for scheduled off-peak windows; lower commit price, preserves commitments to existing large accounts.
- Option B (Aggressive): Try to allocate 200 GPUs by shifting some tranches and using short-term preemption windows for lower-tier customers; needs exec approval and may require credits.
- Option C (Hybrid): 120 GPUs reserved + 80 GPUs on a time-windowed burst (night/weekend) with explicit preemption rights.

Please review sizing_notes.pdf (I exported my quick notes) and advise: can we meet any of these without violating current tranche commitments (Aurum and Helix deals)? Karthik — I know you have the tranche sheet; what’s the earliest we can free up a contiguous block of ~100 GPUs?

Attachments: caldera_capacity_request.xlsx, sizing_notes.pdf

—Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 13:21:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Reserved capacity for Q4 model launch — quick triage

Marissa / team —

On review: the raw numbers would fit into fleet capacity if we accept a higher preemption surface and reallocate from a recently renewed mid-size customer (Aurum). That’s politically and contractually sensitive. A few concrete points:

1) Current committed tranches: Aurum holds 140 reserved GPUs (2028 Q2–Q4). Helix has 60 reserved with strict latency SLOs during our US peak hours.

2) If leadership approves, we can carve a 120 GPU contiguous tranche by moving Aurum’s non-peak window earlier and offering them a 15% credit for tolerance of a new preemption window (23:00–03:00 PST) for 8 weeks. That gets us to Option C in Marissa’s note.

3) For Caldera’s burst-to-260 ask: we can enable burst on the shared pool, but to guarantee it we’d need a formal SLA adjustment and a reserve buffer protocol — otherwise burst is best-effort and can cause noisy-neighbor effects.

Recommend: propose Option C to the customer (120 reserved + 80 time-windowed burst) and concurrently open an executive change request to authorize the Aurum tranche modification and the 15% credit. This requires Rafael / Naom1 sign-off for commercial/CS tradeoffs.

Also, pricing note: the hybrid approach reduces net-new capacity demand by ~40% vs Caldera’s ask; it’s a compromise we can defend in negotiation.

—Karthik Iyer
VP, Capacity Planning | Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 16:48:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Reserved capacity for Q4 model launch — quick triage

Thanks for the analysis. I agree with Karthik’s compromise. Proposed decision:

- Offer Caldera a 6-week firm reservation of 120 GPUs starting 2028-08-10, with a staged extension to 3 months if utilization aligns with the forecast.
- Provide an agreed burst window that allows up to 80 additional GPUs between 22:00–04:00 PST for the first 6 weeks. Bursts are to be preemptible for customers with fixed commitments.
- Offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first-month consumption if Caldera signs a 3-month DocuSign order by 2028-06-10.

I’ll draft the mutual action plan and route to legal/commercial for the tranche modification (Aurum). Rafael — please prepare the credit memo and the DocuSign envelope. Attaching the MAP and the hubspot deal link to this thread.
